name.en: Airport Freeway and Taoyuan Inner Beltway
name.zh: 机场支线与桃园内环线

tagline.en: Twenty kilometres from Taoyuan airport across the two north–south freeways
tagline.zh: 自桃园机场起，二十公里内连通两条南北向高速公路

start.en: Taiwan Taoyuan International Airport, Dayuan, where the freeway becomes the terminal approach roads
start.zh: 桃园市大园区台湾桃园国际机场，主线在此接航站南、北路

end.en: Yingge junction with National Freeway 3, New Taipei
end.zh: 新北市莺歌区莺歌系统交流道，接国道三号

en: National Freeway 2 is a short east–west road, 20.4 km long, across the north of Taoyuan. It starts at the airport in Dayuan, runs south-east past Luzhu and the Taoyuan HSR station, crosses National Freeway 1 at the Airport System interchange, and ends at Yingge in New Taipei on National Freeway 3.

It is two roads joined. West of Freeway 1 is the Airport Branch, the airport's own spur; east of it is the Taoyuan Inner Beltway, built as part of the Northern Second Freeway. With Freeways 1 and 3 and Expressway 66 it closes a ring around Taoyuan.
zh: 国道二号是一条东西向的短程高速公路，全长 20.4 公里，横贯桃园北部。它起于大园的桃园机场，向东南经芦竹与高铁桃园站，在机场系统交流道与国道一号交会，止于新北市莺歌，接国道三号。
它由两条路接成：国道一号以西是机场支线，即机场专用的联络道；以东是桃园内环线，属北二高计划的一部分。它与国道一号、国道三号及台 66 线共同围成桃园的环状路网。

en: From Dayuan to the Airport System interchange the road is eight lanes, four each way — the only east–west national freeway in Taiwan built to that width. East of Freeway 1 it is six. Both were four lanes until a widening of 2009–2012. The first kilometre, from the airport to Dayuan, is six lanes after further work finished in November 2022.

There are seven interchanges, two of them system junctions. Dazhu was added in January 2006 to serve the new high-speed rail station; in April 2013 the Airport System interchange gained ramps to the Wugu–Yangmei viaduct over Freeway 1, eastbound off and westbound on only.
zh: 大园至机场系统交流道为双向八车道，是台湾唯一拥有此规格的东西向国道；国道一号以东为双向六车道。两段原先都只有四车道，2009 至 2012 年拓宽而成。机场端至大园交流道的头一公里，于 2022 年 11 月再次拓宽后为双向六车道。
全线设交流道七座，其中两座为系统交流道。大竹交流道于 2006 年 1 月增设，服务新建的高铁站；2013 年 4 月，机场系统交流道增设衔接五杨高架的匝道，仅东出西入。

en: The airport spur came first: 8.6 km from the airport, then named after Chiang Kai-shek, to Freeway 1, opened in November 1980 and numbered National Freeway 1A. The Freeway Bureau built it.

The eastern half belongs to the second freeway. The National Expressway Engineering Bureau built the Taoyuan Inner Beltway with the Northern Second Freeway, and on 24 August 1997, when it opened through to Yingge, the whole road was renumbered National Freeway 2 and its kilometre posts restarted from the airport.

As airport traffic grew the road jammed. The widening began in mid-2009; the premier, Wu Den-yih, ordered it finished nine months early, and in December 2009 the Liberty Times reported that the hurry had added NT$2.2 billion to the cost. The last section was done on 31 May 2012.

On 19 July 2016 a tour coach taking 24 visitors from Dalian to the airport caught fire on the westbound carriageway; all 26 people on board died. Prosecutors concluded in September that the driver had set the fire deliberately.
zh: 机场支线最先建成：自当时以蒋中正命名的机场至国道一号，长 8.6 公里，1980 年 11 月通车，编为国道一号甲线，由高速公路局兴建。
东半段则属于第二高速公路。桃园内环线由国道新建工程局随北二高一并兴建，1997 年 8 月 24 日通车至莺歌，全线随即改编为国道二号，里程改以机场端为起点计算。
随着机场运量增长，这条路日益拥堵。拓宽工程于 2009 年年中开工；行政院长吴敦义下令提前九个月完工，2009 年 12 月《自由时报》报道，赶工使经费增加 22 亿元。最后一段于 2012 年 5 月 31 日完工。
2016 年 7 月 19 日，一辆载有 24 名大连旅客前往机场的游览车在西行车道起火，车上 26 人全部罹难。检方 9 月侦结，认定司机蓄意纵火。

en: The 2009–2012 widening, including the planned Dayuan branch, was budgeted at about NT$12.87 billion. The Dayuan branch, Freeway 2A, was held up by objections from factory owners and conservationists over the Xucuo Port wetland; its first piece, to Provincial Highway 15, opened in January 2023.
zh: 2009 至 2012 年的拓宽工程连同规划中的大园支线，总建设经费约新台币 128.7 亿元。大园支线（国道二甲）因厂商及环保团体以许厝港湿地为由反对而延宕，首段至台 15 线于 2023 年 1 月通车。

en: The limit is 100 km/h except between the airport and Dayuan interchange, where it is 70 km/h towards the airport and 90 km/h away from it.
zh: 全线速限每小时 100 公里，唯机场端至大园交流道之间，往机场方向限速 70 公里，离开机场方向 90 公里。

why.en: No published cost was found for the 1980 airport spur or for the Taoyuan Inner Beltway on its own; the beltway's cost sits inside the Northern Second Freeway budget (see Freeway 3).
why.zh: 未找到 1980 年机场支线或桃园内环线单独公布的造价；内环线的经费含在北二高计划预算之中（见国道三号）。

value.en: About NT$12.87 billion, including the Dayuan branch as then planned
value.zh: 约新台币 128.7 亿元，含当时规划的大园支线

figures.source: Freeway Bureau, 國道2號拓寬工程, as cited in Chinese Wikipedia, 國道二號 (中華民國)

why.en: The sources found say which bureau built each half (the Freeway Bureau the airport spur, the National Expressway Engineering Bureau the beltway) but not how the money was raised.
why.zh: 所见资料只说明两段分别由高速公路局（机场支线）与国道新建工程局（内环线）兴建，未说明经费来源。

value.en: 20.4 km; 8.6 km of it the original airport spur
value.zh: 20.4 公里，其中原机场支线 8.6 公里

figures.source: Freeway Bureau, as cited in English Wikipedia, National Freeway 2

timeline.en: The 8.6 km airport spur opens in November as National Freeway 1A.
timeline.zh: 11 月，8.6 公里的机场支线通车，编为国道一号甲线。

timeline.en: The Taoyuan Inner Beltway opens to Yingge on 24 August; the road becomes National Freeway 2.
timeline.zh: 8 月 24 日，桃园内环线通车至莺歌，全线改编为国道二号。

timeline.en: Dazhu interchange opens on 23 January for the Taoyuan HSR station.
timeline.zh: 1 月 23 日，为高铁桃园站增设的大竹交流道通车。

timeline.en: The first widened section, Dayuan to Dazhu, opens at eight lanes on 20 April.
timeline.zh: 4 月 20 日，首段拓宽的大园至大竹段以双向八车道通车。

timeline.en: The widening is finished on 31 May.
timeline.zh: 5 月 31 日，拓宽工程全线完工。

timeline.en: Ramps to the Wugu–Yangmei viaduct open at the Airport System interchange on 20 April.
timeline.zh: 4 月 20 日，机场系统交流道衔接五杨高架的匝道通车。

timeline.en: A tour coach fire near the airport on 19 July kills all 26 on board.
timeline.zh: 7 月 19 日，机场附近游览车火烧事故，车上 26 人全部罹难。

timeline.en: The first piece of Freeway 2A, to Provincial Highway 15, opens in January.
timeline.zh: 1 月，国道二甲首段通车至台 15 线。
